short: the page's components, API client and tests
is: The page's source: a layout shell, one component per view, the client of the hub's JSON interface, the control key and its POSTs, and Vitest tests against a fixture hub.
conventions: The control key is read once from the link's fragment (`#key=`), kept in memory for the tab only (never local storage, a cookie or the DOM), stripped from the address and sent only in the X-Zaf-Key header
With `controls: false` in the state, or no key, no button shows
Tests are `*.test.js` beside what they test

fs.name: Action.svelte
fs.role: one control button that shows what happened, or the hub's reason for a refusal

fs.name: AnswerControl.svelte
fs.role: a question to rule on: accept what it proposes, or edit the answer and send that

fs.name: App.svelte
fs.role: the layout shell: the machine line in the header, then Next for you and one section a project; reads the state again on each change

fs.name: App.test.js
fs.role: the shell against a fixture hub's GET /api/state

fs.name: Controls.test.js
fs.role: the key and the control buttons

fs.name: line.js
fs.role: pure helpers of the epic line: turnedDone(previous, next), the tasks that turned done between two reads and whether the whole epic just did; gridRows(squares), the grid's rows, and gridCells(tasks), each square's column and row, column-major in task order

fs.name: NextForYou.svelte
fs.role: the Next for you list, with a copy button for each command

fs.name: NextForYou.test.js
fs.role: one item of every kind, as GET /api/state lists them

fs.name: ProjectSection.svelte
fs.role: one project: its epics, queue and instances, with its controls when the hub serves them and the page holds the key

fs.name: Stream.test.js
fs.role: the change stream, on a stand-in for the browser's EventSource

fs.name: api.js
fs.role: GET /api/state (`{ machine, next, projects }`), watchChanges (holds GET /api/events open, opens a dropped stream again after a second) and the machine line's words

fs.name: app.css
fs.role: light and dark from the system's theme; one column that works at phone width

fs.name: controls.js
fs.role: the control key and `POST /api/<control>`; remembers the projects this tab gave a version for
